allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://suwamed-mobile.vercel.app/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15 -ErrorAction Stop; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\), size=$\($r.Content.Length\), hasReact=$\($r.Content -match '_expo/static/js'\)" } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $r = curl.exe -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X OPTIONS "https://suwamed-backend.vercel.app/api/auth/login" -H "Origin: https://suwamed-mobile.vercel.app" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"; "Preflight from web origin: HTTP $r" } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
